intro.text:
Book Component Demo

This page demonstrates the Book Component with multifield author support. The component uses HTL with a Sling Model (BookModel) to render book information including multiple authors.

book1.bookTitle: Clean Code: A Handbook of Agile Software Craftsmanship
book1.subtitle: A Handbook of Agile Software Craftsmanship
book1.description: Even bad code can function. But if code isn't clean, it can bring a development organization to its knees. This book is a must for any developer who wants to improve their code quality.

author1.bio: Robert Cecil Martin, known as Uncle Bob, is an American software engineer and author. He is a co-author of the Agile Manifesto.

book2.bookTitle: Design Patterns: Elements of Reusable Object-Oriented Software
book2.description: The Gang of Four's classic book on software design patterns that has influenced generations of software developers.

author1.bio: Swiss computer scientist, known for his work on Design Patterns and Eclipse IDE.

author2.bio: Computer scientist and co-author of the Gang of Four Design Patterns book.

author3.bio: Professor at University of Illinois, expert in software frameworks and patterns.

author4.bio: Late computer scientist who made significant contributions to software patterns.

book3.subtitle: Your Journey to Mastery, 20th Anniversary Edition
book3.description: Written by two of the most seasoned software developers, this book examines the core programming process—taking a requirement and producing working, maintainable code.

author1.bio: A founder of the Pragmatic Programmers and co-author of the Agile Manifesto.

author2.bio: Co-founder of the Pragmatic Programmers and Agile Manifesto co-author.

usage-notes.text:
Implementation Notes

Component Structure

  • BookModel (org.apache.sling.cms.reference.models.BookModel) - Sling Model that adapts from Resource
  • Author (org.apache.sling.cms.reference.beans.Author) - Bean class for author data from multifield
  • book.html - HTL template for rendering the component

Multifield Structure

The authors multifield stores each author as a child resource with properties: authorName, email, role, bio, website

HTL Usage

<sly data-sly-use.book="org.apache.sling.cms.reference.models.BookModel">
  <h2>${book.title}</h2>
  <sly data-sly-list.author="${book.authors}">
    <p>${author.name}</p>
  </sly>
</sly>
